card.name: Just before a unit of measure
card.fires_on: Opening parentheses, closing parentheses, and number words just before a unit such as mg/dL, ng/mL, mL/kg/day or kJ/mol. Common in tables and pharmacokinetic text.

modes.label: Bracket before unit
modes.description: An opening parenthesis in a table header or label, right before the unit text.

modes.label: Number or quantity before unit
modes.description: The end of a number or a number word, where a unit like mg/dL or mcg/mL comes next.
modes.example: elevated protein levels up to several<< hundred>> mg/dL, but negative culture results

card.writes: It pushes toward unit and currency-like tokens such as 'Units', ' lb', ' kil' and 'doll', though the effect is mixed.
card.plain: It fires at the spot where a measurement unit like mg/mL is about to appear.
